CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

October 10, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:29 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

Absent:
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: September 12, 2023
  • Board Member Ng asked to pull this item to discussion. Ng stated her motion to
  approve September 12, 2023, meeting minutes are incorrect. Ng abstained and
  did not vote.

ITEM 2:  2817 Front Street

  •  This is an application for three (3) door replacements and ten (10) window
  replacements on an existing 1-story house. All proposed door and window
  replacements are similar in size and style to the existing, where casement window
  openings comply with the minimum required per building department.
  •  Applicant: Carolina Tommasino
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Representative Robert Diaz was present.

  1
 MOTION:
  • Chairman Udani moved to approve all consent items.
  • The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: September 12, 2023

  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Board Member Ng asked to pull this item to discussion. Ng stated her
  motion to approve September 12, 2023, meeting minutes are incorrect. Ng
  abstained and did not vote. Ng ask that staff correct the vote on the minutes
  accordingly.

MOTION:

  •  Ng makes a motion to continue the item and correct the vote count on the
  September 12, 2023 meeting minutes.
  •  The motion was carried by the board.

ITEM 3:  28 East Valley Boulevard

  •  This is an application for site improvements to install a new 3 ft. high iron fence
  around an existing parking lot with two vehicular sliding gates and a new 6 ft. high
  decorative block wall.
  •  Applicant: Ming Liu
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Ming Liu was not present. Board Member Ng noted a
  concern about the one-way traffic exiting Valley Boulevard and how drivers
  entering the site may run into vehicles exiting the parking lot. Staff clarified that the
  existing parking layout is not changing the direction of traffic. Ng also asked Staff
  if the project meets the number of accessible parking stalls required by code. Staff
  did not have a definitive answer but reminded the Board that Planning Staff has
  reviewed the parking layout and required number of stalls, and has no comments
  on this subject. Board Member Hernandez noted that the Design Board is not
  reviewing the number of parking spaces or parking layout for this Design Review.
  Ng asked where the proposed bushes and trees are being located. Staff noted that
  currently the plans show a new tree being proposed on the northeast corner of the
  site, in between the existing two bushes. Chairman Udani asked where the new
  decorative block wall is located. Staff identified the general location of the new wall.
  Udani and Hernandez noted that the drawings are not clear where the block wall
  starts and ends.

  2
 MOTION:

  •  Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) Provide a dimension, in degrees, for the fence angle with respect to
  the property line; or show typical dimensions for the angled fence; 2) identify the
  permeable surface material used on the interior side of the fence next to the
  parking stall; and 3) The applicant shall revise any drafting errors found on the
  plans; and 4) Clearly identify the length of the proposed decorative block wall.
  •  The second was by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 4:  1624 Front Street

  •  This is an application for new construction of a 1,222 SF 2-story Second Unit
  residence with an attached 2-car garage located in the rear.
  •  Applicant: William Zhao
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant William Zhao was present. Board Member Ng noted that the
  proposed exterior lighting fixtures and balcony fencing do not provided
  specifications or product details, similar to what is shown in the material and finish
  schedule. Staff agrees. Board Member Daninger notes that the proposed balcony
  sliding door height does not line up with the proposed windows. The applicant
  agrees and will plan to revise the door height. Udani noted that some keynotes in
  elevations are not corresponding to the correct material identified in the materials
  and finish schedule.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions: 1) The applicant shall revise the drawings for any drafting
  errors on the door and window heights on the West Elevation; 2) The elevation
  callout / keynotes shall be revised to accurately identify the materials and finishes
  in elevation; 3) The applicant must provide further details on exterior lighting
  fixtures and railing, such as providing specifications or product documentation; and
  4) The applicant must resubmit a revised set of plans for the City Architect to
  review.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

  3
 E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on October 10, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Ng moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:00 P.M.
  •  The second was by Vice Chairman Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
